blind.description: A stylized fantasy/medieval bakery market stall. It features a timber frame structure with four corner posts, muted green side panels, and a pitched awning with orange and cream fabric stripes. The wooden counter and front area are stocked with various baked goods, including round loaves, buns, trays of pastries, and two woven wicker baskets filled with upright baguettes (one resting on the floor in front, one on the counter). Textures have a hand-painted stylized finish.
blind.from_above: A rectangular striped orange-and-cream pitched awning framed by wooden corner caps and a central ridge beam, with a small oval basket containing oblong bread loaves protruding at the front bottom edge.
blind.height_vs_figure: Slightly shorter than the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 4.5 to 5 ft tall at the awning ridge), and roughly 4 to 4.5 ft wide.
